lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal BaMg14Cu phase (space group I4_2m, No. 143) has a 32-atom unit cell containing Ba2Mg28Cu2 and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows Ba and Cu each adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers display 12-neighbor environments of mixed Ba, Cu, and Mg coordination. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, with Mg–Mg polyhedra also showing edge- and face-sharing.
